message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Step | What Happens | Key Points | |------|--------------|------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | • If the first card is an action card, its effect applies immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the next player draws two and skips a turn). | | **2. Turn Order** | • Players take turns clockwise (or counterclockwise if a “Reverse” card is played). | • The goal is to get rid of all your cards. | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile.
• If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | • You can only play one card per turn unless you’re using special rules (see below). | | **4. Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | • “Wild Draw Four” can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise, you risk being challenged. | | **5. Winning a Round** | • When a player discards their last card, they shout “Uno!” if they have one card left.
• If they forget, the next player draws two penalty cards.
• The round ends when a player has no cards left. | • The winner scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands. | | **6. Scoring** | • Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each.
• Winner gets the total sum of those points. | • First player to reach 500 points (or another agreed threshold) wins the game. | | **7. Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – Some players allow stacking of “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” cards.
• **Seven-O** – Play a 7 to swap hands with another player; play a 0 to rotate everyone’s hands.
• **Speed** – Play without drawing from the pile; whoever runs out of cards first wins. | • Clarify house rules before starting. | **Quick Tips** * Keep track of the current color so you know what you can play. * Use “Wild” cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. * Pay attention to opponents’ cards—if someone plays a “Wild Draw Four,” you can challenge them if you suspect they had a matching color card. Enjoy playing Uno!
